long_biography.plain_text:
Cheuk Nang Holdings reflects Cecil Chao Sze-Tsung's blend of architecture and property investment. Trained at Durham University and registered as an architect in Hong Kong, he first worked in the government's buildings and architectural offices. His father, shipping entrepreneur Chao Tsong-Yea, supplied the capital for Chao's first property company, giving him a family-backed entry into development.

When the shipping business later needed to sell that company, Chao bought a listed shell and renamed it Cheuk Nang in 1988. He used the new platform to develop residential and commercial property across Hong Kong and other Asian markets while continuing to draw many principal plans himself. He remains founder, executive chairman and chief executive of the group. His private holding companies remain Cheuk Nang's controlling shareholders.

When the shipping business later needed to sell that company, Chao bought a listed shell and renamed it Cheuk Nang in 1988. He used the new platform to develop residential and commercial property across Hong Kong and other Asian markets while continuing to draw many principal plans himself. He remains founder, executive chairman and chief executive of the group. His private holding companies remain Cheuk Nang's controlling shareholders.
